SA--42
SUSPENSION AND AXLE ,, FRONT LOWER SUSPENSION ARM
REMOVAL
1. REMOVE FRONT WHEEL
Torque: 103 N•m (1,050 kgf.cm, 76 ft,lbf}
2. Mrr or A/T RH side:
REMOVE LOWER SUSPENSION ARM
(a) Remove the f:ngine under cover.
{b) Remove the bolt and 2 nuts, and disconnect the lower
suspension arm from the tower ball joint.
Torque: 142 N.m (1,450 kgf.cm, 105 ft-lbf)
F0225J
(c) Remove the 2 bolts, nut and lower suspension arm.
Torque: 137 N•m {1 1397 kgf.cm, 101 ft•lbf)
HINT:
At the time of installation, after stabilizing the suspension,
torque the bolts.
3. A/T LH side:
REMOVE LOWER SUSPENSION ARM
(a) Remove the engine under covers,
(b) Disconnect the RH and LH tie rod ends.
(1) Remove the cotter pin and nut.
Torque: 49 N.m (500 kgf.cm, 36 ft•lbf)
HINT:
At the time of installation, if the holes for a new cotter pin are not
aligned, tighten the nut further up to 60°.
(2) Using SST, disconnect the tie rod end from the
steering knuckle.
SST 09610-20012
(3) Employ the same manner described above to the
other side.
